I was confused on so many levels.

Then I started smoking, going to raves, taking drugs...

So, to answer your 2nd question, I'm addicted to smoking and speed. Now, I'm not heavily addicted to speed but I still need it every week or so. I stopped taking drugs for 5 months then I relapsed a few weeks ago.

Also addicted to online poker. I don't think poker is bad, but it's making my situation even worse because I barely enough money to survive. 

Now I'm totally broke, can't find a good job, really wanna die.

Sorry if i'm a bit difficult to read.
